st: The Case of the Nervous Neighbor
d: A woman who is stricken with amnesia is accused of murdering her husband. After she is cleared, her son faces embezzlement charges, and ultimately a charge of murder.

st: The Case of the Fifty-Millionth Frenchman
d: An ingenuous young Frenchman is accused of murdering the husband of the woman he hopes to marry.

st: The Case of the Frightened Fisherman
d: A brilliant young scientist is accused of his deceitful, greedy wife.
The government's first 100 days in office threatens to be overshadowed by a new scandal.
An economic dilemma arises when a new gender equality bill upsets the country's most powerful industrialist.
An official visit by the president of a former Soviet republic makes headlines when he demands the arrest of a prominent political activist.

st: See No Evil, Hear No Evil, Speak No Evil
d: The discovery of illegal surveillance of the Solidarity Party prompts its leader to accuse the government of spying on political opponents.
While the prime minister takes a family holiday, the publication of a tell-all memoir by a former politician puts spin doctor Kasper Juul on the edge.
Allegations of corruption in connection with military spending brings unfortunate consequences, including for the prime minister's husband.
A year after taking office, the prime minister fights for survival against low approval ratings, political turmoil, and a failing marriage.

st: The Case of the Arrogant Arsonist
d: A retired fire chief is accused of arson and murder.

st: The Case of the Garrulous Go-Between
d: A young woman, trying to trap the fradulent fortuneteller she blames for her father's ruin, instead becomes implicated in a murder.

st: The Case of the Woeful Widower
d: An embittered housekeeper tells Perry Mason that her invalid employer is in danger of being murdered by her husband.

st: The Case of the Simple Simon
d: An actress who is seeking her long-lost son becomes implicated in the murder of a drama critic.

st: The Case of the Illicit Illusion
d: A woman who presumably has been killed in an airplane crash returns from the dead... only to be murdered.

st: The Case of the Careless Kidnapper
d: A doctor who is conducting experimental alcoholism treatments on prominent persons is arrested for the murder of the blackmailer who threatened to reveal the names of his patients.
